_note: The 11 September 2026 batch from 28 May 2026, plus the associated revival window and political claims. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: An hourglass nearly empty, with the message that the time extended in 2015 has run out, and at 11 September he sees a ground zero with a flag standing in it.
mentions.quote: as I got to September the 11th, 911, I saw ground zero
mentions.falsify_match: A mass-casualty attack or comparable ground-zero event in the United States on or about 11 September 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: 11 September 2026 passes without such an event.

mentions.claim_text: The rubble is one major building rather than twin towers, with a bent flag placed crookedly in the middle of it.
mentions.quote: It was not twin towers. It was one major building
mentions.falsify_match: A single large building destroyed, not a paired structure.
mentions.falsify_miss: No building collapse, or a different pattern entirely.

mentions.claim_text: Massive steel beams stand up out of the ground like wreckage, similar to the first 9/11, and he notes that 11 September this year falls on Rosh Hashanah.
mentions.quote: September the 11th of this year, is Rashashana
mentions.condition_text: he calls the church to pray over the date
mentions.falsify_match: A structural attack in the US over the Rosh Hashanah period 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: The date passes without incident, which he pre-attributes to intercession.

mentions.claim_text: A two-year window for major revival opens on 11 September this year and runs into the next shmita cycle of 2028 and 2029.
mentions.quote: A 2year window for a major revival
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable in practice: revival has no agreed measure.

mentions.claim_text: Darkness comes on America taking freedom of speech, especially on social media through censorship and fact checking, tied to the coming midterm election.
mentions.quote: taking our freedom of speech, especially concerning social media
mentions.time_phrase: in the days ahead, around the midterms
mentions.falsify_match: New speech restrictions or platform censorship rules around the 2026 midterms.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such measures by the midterms.

mentions.claim_text: A coup attempt to oust Trump before his term ends, in the shape of another January 6th style event, with plots against his children.
mentions.quote: a coup concerning ousting President Trump before his time
mentions.falsify_match: An organised attempt to remove the president outside an election.

mentions.claim_text: A vast wheat field with two silos, one bursting open and the other barely full, alongside a rooster crowing and the harvest.
mentions.quote: one silo was busting open and the other silo was hardly full
mentions.falsify_match: A split grain harvest, abundance in one place and shortfall in another.
mentions.falsify_miss: Unfalsifiable as stated: the imagery has no named referent.
